messages.subject: Need Help! Uploading .Rdata files
parts:
Hi!


For my website application, I need to be abble to upload Rdata files, but I don't succeed... I saw a lot of code, but I don't know how to adapt it for my case, because generally it's csv files that are upload...

Let me introduce my ui.R code for the upload:

library(shiny)

shinyui(pageWithSidebar(
  headerPanel("Upload Rdata files")

  sidebarPanel(
    fileInput("f1","First file", multiple=FALSE, accept=NULL),
    fileInput("f2","Second file", multiple=FALSE, accept=NULL)
)
))

And now the server.R code:
out <- reactive(function(){
  if (is.null(input$f1)){
    ff1 <- NULL}
  else {
    ff1 <- input$f1$datapath
}

data(ff1)

Same thing for the second file.

Then I have to make some job with it, but i don't think that it's important here...


R tell me that I have some troubles with reactive, but when I wasn't using this function it was tolding me to use reactive function...
And data(ff1) tell me that there is no data calling ff1...


Thaks for helping me!

Maxence Ory

messages.subject: Re: Need Help! Uploading .Rdata files
parts:
out <- reactive(function(){
  if (is.null(input$f1)){
    ff1 <- NULL}
  else {
    ff1 <- input$f1$datapath
}

data(ff1)

You'd need this:

sessionEnvir <- sys.frame()
observe({
  if (!is.null(input$f1)){
    load(input$f1$datapath, sessionEnvir)
})

However I have a feeling that you actually want a reactiveValues() object and to assign values from .RData into there; I can't give you any more hints than that without knowing more about your app though.

Be very careful to consider if it's possible for a malicious user to access your app and upload arbitrary nastiness via the .RData file!

library(shiny)

shinyServer(function(input, output, session) {
